subject: Co-sell certification gateways & procurement timeline for CloudWise listing
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudwise.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@cloudwise.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 11:14:00 -0400
Subject: Marketplace co-sell: certification gates + docs we need

Hi Evelyn and Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — CloudWise is excited about the integration with Redwood Inference. The marketplace team at Microsoft asked us to confirm the following so they can accelerate the co-sell certification for AWS/Azure/GCP bundles:

- Formal listing owner and contact for security evidence (SOC2, data handling)
- A short operations runbook for billing and support handoffs
- Mutual action plan (timeline to listing + co-sell enablement)
- Procurement terms point of contact for marketplace contract flow

Can you share the items you can provide this week? We can push the co-sell readiness review if we have the vendor evidence + an MP owner in place.

Attachments: none (we can upload to the shared drive)

Best,
Amanda
Head of Partnerships | CloudWise Inc.
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudwise.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: certification gates + docs we need

Amanda — great to connect. High level next steps below; I've attached our readiness checklist and an initial mutual action plan (MAP). Short answers inline: 

- Listing owner: Evelyn Hart (I will be the Redwood listing owner and the MP POC)
- Security evidence: We can provide SOC 2 Type II report, encryption/KMS summary, and our evidence matrix by EOD Wed (link in MAP)
- Ops runbook: Draft included in the MAP; we propose bi-weekly support sync during the first 90 days and a single escalation path via support@redwood.ai
- Procurement contact: Ben Carter (handles marketplace contracting for co-sell commercial terms)

Proposed timeline: upload evidence by Wed (11th), formal technical review with Microsoft on Fri (13th), co-sell enablement workshop week of Apr 23. If that works for you I will start the HubSpot record and a shared Drive folder.

Attachments: redwood_marketplace-readiness-checklist.pdf, cloudwise_mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — 
Evelyn Hart
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudwise.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: certification gates + docs we need

Amanda / Evelyn —
Quick add on procurement: CloudWise will need a standard marketplace EULA and a purchasing flow doc for each cloud. I can prepare a high-level contracting checklist for Azure marketplace and GCP Marketplace (they each have slightly different invoicing/entitlement flows).

Questions for CloudWise team: Do you plan to use Microsoft partner-submitted listing or co-managed listing? (That affects the metadata we have to supply and the timeline.)

I will also copy our billing engineer into the Drive folder after we confirm list type.

Ben
Sr. Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudwise.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: azure-marketplace@microsoft.com, procurements@cloudwise.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: certification gates + docs we need

Ben / Evelyn —
Thanks, Ben. CloudWise prefers a partner-submitted listing on Microsoft and co-managed on GCP (separate teams). We will confirm the GCP co-managed point on our side by Wednesday. Procurement will need your contracting checklist for Azure and an approximate lead time for signatures (our legal typically needs ~10 business days once the paperwork is in Docusign).

One additional ask from Microsoft: they want a short case study blurb (1–2 paragraphs) outlining a joint customer scenario that demonstrates co-sell value (who handles infra, who owns support, and references to typical latency/cost outcomes). Could Redwood draft a 1-paragraph blurb (we can iterate) by EOD Thu?

Amanda
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@cloudwise.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: certification gates + docs we need

Amanda — attaching a short draft blurb for the Microsoft review and confirming timelines.

Draft blurb (please feel free to edit):
"Redwood Inference and CloudWise deliver a turnkey LLM inference offering where CloudWise handles customer onboarding and marketplace subscription fulfillment while Redwood powers low-latency, cost-optimized model serving across multi-cloud environments. Together we provide customers predictable inference economics with integrated billing and a single support entry point; typical P95 latency for the validated configuration is under 150ms and customers see a 20–35% reduction in per-token inference cost through our batching and caching optimizations."

I also added a row in the MAP with the signature SLA expectations and a tentative co-sell enablement date of Apr 24. Ben — I'll follow up for the procurement checklist and will loop our billing engineer into the Drive folder once we get the MS listing path confirmed.

Attachments: none (MAP updated in Drive)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
